checks.witness: Hebrew and Septuagint: The KJV says that in their self-will Simeon and Levi digged down a wall. The Hebrew as pointed says they hamstrung an ox, and Brenton’s Greek says they hamstrung a bull.

Septuagint: Brenton’s Greek of the psalm’s opening cry has a request the KJV lacks, “attend to me”, and where the KJV has “the words of my roaring” it has “the words of my transgressions”. The cry at Matthew 27:46 has neither Greek difference.
